#### What this PR does / why we need it:
This pull request (PR) adds support for defining scoped resources in the `APIService model`. It introduces the `ResourceScope type and the `ScopedResource` struct, allowing resources to be grouped based on their scope (Cluster or Namespace).

The changes in this PR enhance resource management, alleviate backend pressure, and facilitate seamless migrations for a more efficient and scalable Kubernetes cluster.

comments:
Hey @armstrongli, if I am not wrong I need to make changes in both the places?
`staging/src/k8s.io/kube-aggregator/pkg/apis/apiregistration/v1/types.go`
and
`staging/src/k8s.io/kube-aggregator/pkg/apis/apiregistration/v1beta1/types.go`

or by making the changes in only one place (v1/types.go), you ensure that both versions use the updated APIServiceSpec model with `Kind and ResourceScope` support.

hi @AryanSharma9917 , thank you for your passion on the request. this ticket is a feature request to support Kind & Scope exposure for APIService to do aggregation . the model part declares what resources are exposed and focused. the aggregation apiserver also requires logic change to only forward the focused requests to the corresponding backend service. 

there are changes on the v1/types, v1beta2(in theory on model changes) or v1beta1 to add the extra fields. it is also needed to change the apiregistration/types.go, as well as the conversions to guarantee the backword compatibility.

/cc @deads2k 
/triage accepted

From a first glance this seems to make APIService function like discovery. From your description i did not understand why you needed APIService specifically to have these fields

hi @alexzielenski, we are on the way breaking our mono application into micro services, and we have a big group with range of resources inside. we break the resources into groups by business domains. but we need to do backward compatibility and also make sure the resources are served in each domains' services. so we want to have original mono APIs continued running without any impact. then we migrate traffic phase by phase.

the APIService object's granularity is on Group, and it makes everything wired together and can't have further operations, if the design didn't happen properly.
@AryanSharma9917 one more thing to note that the namespace controller also requires changes to make sure the resource discovery part focus only on the resources declared if the fields are set up .
